harness_gate.rule: O0 must reproduce oracle_within_sample within one structure or nothing is scored
harness_gate.earlier_harness_rejected: a first version generated candidates from every view pair instead of oracle_within_sample's anchor pair and scored 198/185; the gate caught it and the harness was corrected before any condition was read

removal_reaches_reconstructor.conclusion: the masks are real and do perturb reconstruction; they do not change symmetry recovery

mechanism: a site is observable in a view if ANY of its 2x2x2=8 supercell copies is unoccluded there. Informative occlusion hits few copies of a site, and with five cameras losing one or two still leaves the two triangulation needs. Redundant occlusion is more common and more correlated across copies, which is why the CONTROL removes structures.

axis_vs_oblique.finding: the PRE-REGISTERED prediction is CONFIRMED and larger than stated: the three axis views carry 2.2-3.3x the occlusion of the two oblique views, so every occlusion figure published before this extension was measured on the worst cameras in the protocol
